map.标准差衡量打分的离散/分化程度，越大说明评价越两极（口碑分化），越小说明意见越一: The standard deviation measures how dispersed or polarised the scores are; the larger it is, the more polarised the ratings (reputation divides), and the smaller it is, the more consistent the opinions.
